alerts.title: Carbamazepine Toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest monitoring for carbamazepine toxicity. Patient shows symptoms of carbamazepine toxicity, with a level of 14 mcg/mL, above the therapeutic range. This could be due to the drug itself, but other factors like drug interactions should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Reduce carbamazepine dose and monitor levels
